reviews.t: Coloring is useless, brush is good
reviews.x: If you're looking at this set for the coloring pen, don't waste your money, the coloring is garbage and not at all durable - it's in no way waterproof or sweatproof, you can lick your finger and rub it off, making it on par with using a washable Crayola marker on your face.  That said, the only reason I gave this any stars was the brush is pretty good for taming unruly shorter beard and mustaches, of medium firmness to do its work without being too harsh on the face.

I was a little skeptical that this would work for my beard issue.  I have thin growth along the sides and thick around my mouth/chin.  I also have a patch where no hair grows.  This works amazingly well, and I finally have a beard that looks uniform, thicker and healthy!  The dark brown was a perfect color match for me.

claims.text: Many reviewers report the pen arrives dried out or dries out quickly, making it unusable.
Several reviewers say the tip breaks or retracts into the chamber and stops working.
Multiple reviewers praise the natural-looking color blend and ease of filling in beard patches.
Some reviewers find the coloring not durable, not waterproof or sweatproof, and rubs off easily.
A few reviewers note fast delivery and good value for the price.
